newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Blue Star NZ opens systems integration division.
newsitem.headline: Blue Star NZ opens systems integration division.

text.p: Blue Star Group Ltd, a unit of U.S. Office Products, on Friday said it was establishing a new division as part of its strategy to grow its office technology and systems businesses, primarily in Australasia.
The new Business Solutions Division would be headed by Anthony Howard, currently chief executive of Wang New Zealand Ltd, a Blue Star subsidiary.
The division would comprise Blue Star's office and technology and information systems businesses including PC Direct, Hart Candy, U-Bix, Blue Star Office Automation, Wang and Imaging Solutions.

"We've got a number of businesses that are operating independently in an environment that's rapidly converging, and we really want to be a driver of that convergence as opposed to a victim of it," Howard told Reuters.
He said Australasia was the group's targeted growth area at present, and the goal was to be a major force in the technology and systems sectors in both New Zealand and Australia.
However, U.S. Office Products had adopted a similar strategy in the United States and had recently acquired several systems and technology companies.
"And they have bought a number of systems integration companies...I guess at some stage we may link the two together," Howard said.
Howard said growing the group's earnings was a fundamental objective of the new division, which he would run from Auckland.
